6826.title: Distinct failed requests accumulate recovery turns in one thread
6826.rootCauseOneLine: Retry admission deduplicates by original request, so later failed requests in the same thread each enqueue and dispatch a separate recovery turn.
6826.proposedFix: Define compatible retry-coalescing semantics that preserve unaccepted input, execution tuples, ordering, and retry-chain provenance before adding thread-scoped admission.
6826.caveats: Reproduced directly in two clean trusted checkouts with real migrated SQLite and synthetic provider events; no live subscriptions or production fleet used. Regression patch and verbatim output are inline in the report. No simple fix proposed because combining distinct execution tuples and retry chains requires product policy.
